title: Adherence Packaging and Per-Cycle Pharmacist Review Standard — Auto Refill & Medication Sync
content:
Where an Auto Refill & Medication Sync program dispenses in adherence packaging, each cycle is dispensed as adherence cards covering the program's card days, prepared with the program's packaging preparation days of extra lead time. Where the program does not dispense in adherence packaging, the cycle is dispensed in ordinary vials.

## Standard

**S1. Cards.** Each cycle of a packaging program is dispensed as cards covering the program's card days, prepared with the program's preparation days of extra lead time.

**S2. Dose changes.** A dose change reaches the next packs only when it is on file at least the program's dose-change cut-off, in calendar days, before processing. A later change is dispensed separately in a vial until the next cycle.

**S3. Controlled substances.** Where the program does not allow controlled substances in packs, controlled substances are never placed in the packs and stay in vials.

**S4. Pharmacist review.** Where the program provides a pharmacist review each cycle, a pharmacist reviews the patient's whole medication list before each cycle is dispensed.

**S5. No packaging.** Where the program does not dispense in adherence packaging, the cycle is dispensed in ordinary vials.

## How the contents of a packaging cycle are dispensed

| Item | Dispensed |
|---|---|
| Doses on file by the dose-change cut-off | In the cards |
| A dose change on file later than the cut-off | Separately in a vial until the next cycle |
| A controlled substance, where the program does not allow them in packs | In a vial |

## Dose-change boundary (hypothetical inputs)

With a dose-change cut-off of 5 calendar days and a processing date of 15 July:

- a change on file on 10 July is on file 5 days before processing, meets the cut-off and reaches the next packs;
- a change on file on 11 July is on file 4 days before processing, is later than the cut-off and is dispensed separately in a vial until the next cycle.
